newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 15 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 15 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 15 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Belleville Comm. No.522, Ill., $3.9 million general obligation bonds.
--Niles Public Library District, Ill., $3.875 million library GOs.
--Malden, Mass., $4.4 million muni purpose loan GOs.
--Maryland Depart of Transportation, Md., $50 million revenue bonds.
--Duluth, Minn., $1.960 million GO equipment certificates and $1.285 million GOs.
--Sachem CSD, N.Y., school district bonds $7.2 million.
--Portland, Oregon, $110 million sewer system revenue bonds.
--Grove City Area SD, Pa., $5 million GOs and $5 million GOs.
--Fort Bend Cty MUD No. 27, Texas, $2 million waste water and san. sewer bonds.
--Lower Colorado River Authority, Texas, $1 million refunding revenue bonds and $204.170 million refunding revenue bonds.
